description: This file defines an interface (IStorageManager) for managing storage-related operations within the WPEFramework. It declares methods for creating, retrieving, deleting, and clearing storage associated with applications, along with relevant parameters and expected behavior.

classes.name: IStorageManager
classes.description: An interface for managing storage operations such as creating, retrieving, deleting, and clearing storage associated with applications within the framework.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates a storage location for a specified application ID with a given size in KB, returning the storage path or an error reason.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the storage location, size, and used space for a specified application ID, user ID, and group ID.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Deletes storage for a specified application ID, returning an error reason if applicable.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears storage data for a specified application ID, including device storage.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all application storage data except for exempted app IDs, as specified.
